title: Show the five-cell floor depends on the block basis
body:
## Summary
- Three private lines and one 4-dimensional block give `n_1 = 3` and `n_3 = 4`. The VVV floor is 15 and the MMM tariff is 18.
- The only free-cell set of block weight 4 is `{A_free, B_free}`. In the basis `f_j = sum_{i ≠ j} e_i`, `e_0 · f_2 = 1`, so those cells are adjacent and the floor is missed.
- Replacing each `f_j` by `e_j` removes that edge, and the same set attains 15. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
